webamp 2.2.0
https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp
https://www.npmjs.com/package/webamp

Pinned file: built/webamp.bundle.min.js (UMD, window.Webamp)
Source: https://unpkg.com/webamp@2.2.0/built/webamp.bundle.min.js
SHA-256 (after stripping the sourceMappingURL comment):
  e416f79b94d549f7d531b365e9751c5932c6b2dc5990d062aa52bd41f22d190c

The default Winamp 2.91-look skin is compiled into that bundle as CSS
(Webamp's own MIT distribution). This tree does not ship Nullsoft's
llama MP3 or a separate .wsz of their bitmaps. User-dropped .wsz skins
and MP3s live in the app's saved data, not at a URL.

Rebuild (needs the network, not part of build.mjs):

  node apps/webamp/vendor.mjs
